changelog:
- Major update: Skill is redesigned to generate structured, full-spectrum test case sets based on system architecture and acceptance checklists.
- Expanded coverage to include functional, performance, security, and compatibility testing.
- Introduced structured output format with priority (P0/P1/P2), covering all key test details.
- Added guidelines for test case density per module complexity.
- Workflow now includes input parsing, coverage analysis, grouped generation by priority, quality checks, and structured output.
- Updated metadata and triggers to reflect broader capabilities; obsolete files removed.
summary: 根据系统架构方案和验收清单，自动生成结构化的全量测试用例，覆盖功能测试、性能测试、安全测试和兼容性测试，按P0/P1/P2优先级排序。
